name: QA Pass
description: Systematic QA testing pass. Select a tier, run structured testing, report findings with severity, optionally auto-fix. Produces health score and ship-readiness verdict.
context_rules: Never fix bugs without user approval unless auto-fix is explicitly enabled. Always produce before/after health scores.

steps.name: Select QA Tier
steps.instruction: Present QA tier options: A) QUICK (~5 min, P0/P1 only), B) STANDARD (~15 min, includes P2), C) EXHAUSTIVE (~30+ min, includes P3/P4). Default to STANDARD if no response within 30 seconds.
steps.validation_prompt: Did the user select a QA tier (QUICK, STANDARD, or EXHAUSTIVE)?

steps.name: Run Critical Path Tests
steps.description: Test auth, core actions, data integrity, error states, and security basics
steps.instruction: Run the qa-tester skill with the selected tier. Test: 1) Auth flow (valid/invalid/expired), 2) Core action (end-to-end), 3) Data integrity (CRUD cycle), 4) Error states (bad input, network failure), 5) Security basics (exposed secrets, missing auth, CORS). Report each finding with P0-P4 severity, confidence, and repro steps.
steps.verification: All critical paths tested. Findings documented with severity, confidence, and repro steps.
steps.validation_prompt: Were all critical paths tested? Are findings documented with severity, confidence, and repro steps?

steps.name: Run Additional Tests
steps.description: Test forms, navigation, loading states, empty states, responsive (if STANDARD/EXHAUSTIVE)
steps.instruction: If STANDARD or EXHAUSTIVE: Test form validation, navigation (all links, back button, deep links), loading states (spinners during async ops), empty states (what shows with no data), responsive (375px, 768px, 1280px+). If EXHAUSTIVE also: visual consistency, hover/focus states, animations, accessibility (tab order, aria labels, contrast), console (zero errors/warnings).
steps.verification: Additional tests completed per selected tier
steps.validation_prompt: Were the tier-appropriate additional tests completed and documented?

steps.name: Produce Health Score
steps.description: Generate before/after health scores and ship-readiness verdict
steps.instruction: Produce the QA HEALTH SCORE. Calculate: critical paths (weight 40%), error handling (25%), UI states (15%), responsive (10%), accessibility (10%). Show before/after if fixes were applied. Produce SHIP READINESS verdict: SHIP (all P0/P1 resolved), CONDITIONAL (P2 remain, documented), BLOCKED (P0/P1 unresolved). Log findings to learnings-keeper.
steps.verification: Health score produced. Ship-readiness verdict given. Learnings logged.
steps.validation_prompt: Was a health score produced? Is the ship-readiness verdict clear? Were learnings logged?

variables.name: target_url
variables.description: URL of the app to test
